description: createPaymentSession: Stage a Stripe checkout session to add funds to the account balance. Requires authentication. Returns an actionId; present the summary to the user, then call executeConfirmedAction with the actionId if they approve. The executed result includes checkoutUrl (hand it to the human to pay) and expiresAt; then poll getPaymentTransactions until the balance credit appears.

amount.description: Amount to add to the balance, in the account currency as a decimal (e.g. 25.00).

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.

name: createPaymentSession
